# Annex B - Compatibility matrix {#sec-annex-b}

AEE is standalone. The core addons depend only on CBA. Compatibility
addons load only when their host mod is present. Each compat addon gates
on its host with `skipWhenMissingDependencies`.

| Compat addon | Host | Integration |
|---|---|---|
| `aee_compat_ace3` | ACE3 | Disables ACE3 weather simulation; exposes the weather report and altimeter in the ACE interaction menu; medical integration |
| `aee_compat_acm` | Advanced Combat Environment (ACM) | Medical integration |
| `aee_compat_acre2` | ACRE2 | Radio propagation hand-off |
| `aee_compat_kat` | KAT - Advanced Medical | Circulation and medical effects |
| `aee_compat_tfar` | TFAR | Radio propagation hand-off |

## ACE3 weather

AEE drives the engine weather directly (`setWind`, `setFog`). ACE3's weather
module reads engine state, so it follows AEE automatically. The ACE3 compat
addon disables ACE3's own wind, rain, fog, and overcast simulation to avoid
two models fighting.

## Keybinds

The weather report and altimeter are also available without ACE3 through
CBA keybinds, under the AEE category in the CBA keybind settings.
